summary: Epson supplies POS receipt printers, kitchen display/impact printers, and labeling hardware for restaurant front- and back-of-house operations, describing itself as a market leader in POS printing solutions; current products include the OmniLink TM-T88VII receipt printer, OmniLink TM-L100 liner-free label printer, and TM-U220II kitchen/receipt impact printer. (Scope note: "Market leader" is a self-description from Epson's own press materials, not an independent market-share study.)
Epson planned to showcase its connected restaurant technology ecosystem, including POS and kitchen printing hardware, at FS/TEC 2026.

Epson also planned to showcase POS, labeling, and print technology for restaurants at the National Restaurant Association Show 2026 (May 16-19, Chicago). (Scope note: Exact press-release day not confirmed beyond the show dates it references.)
